description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 24.05.2021 to 30.05.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes a new legal/regulatory framework for currency conversion in customs transactions. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory compliance requirements.
